events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival of Music & Art, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being there: 1969, three days of peace, love, and music. The legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off on this day. What's your ultimate festival anthem?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas; he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago today, we lost a true lyrical genius. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his powerful impact on music and culture.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London on this day in 1970, he would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar and left an indelible mark on music. His legacy lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring timeless tracks, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs – pure magic. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! A true rock trailblazer with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless solo album 'Imagine', featuring the iconic title track, on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a game-changer that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens and introduced us to the iconic 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Tribute to Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. An incredibly diverse and influential record. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost one of its greatest showmen, Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
